41 of 44 PDFs were renamed to `YYYY-MM-DD_vendor.pdf`. Three were skipped because they're image-only scans with no text layer, so no date or vendor could be read: `scan_0012.pdf`, `scan_0013.pdf`, and `IMG_2231.pdf`.

These need OCR or a manual rename. If you give me the dates and vendors, I'll rename them, or I can try OCR on them if you'd like.

I haven't verified the 41 renames beyond the tool reporting success. The date and vendor came from text extraction, so a spot-check is worthwhile if any invoices list several dates (invoice, due, service period).
